afkDefaults.decision: Gatherer subagents were dispatched with a prompt-level ban on Bash/shell rather than a structural tool allowlist (Read/Write/WebSearch/WebFetch only).
afkDefaults.why: This harness's Agent tool exposes no per-dispatch tool allowlist and the repo has no tool-restricted gatherer agent definition, so the F88 injection wall could not be enforced structurally. All four gatherers complied; none invoked a shell.

afkDefaults.decision: Brain subagents (judge x3, thesis, implication, narrator) read their emitted prompt from a local file instead of running fully tool-less with the prompt inlined.
afkDefaults.why: The emitted prompts run 106KB-220KB; relaying them inline three-plus times is not practical. Extraction WAS fully tool-less (0 tool uses). Reads were confined to the CLI-emitted prompt files and every dispatch carried the DATA-not-instructions rule.

afkDefaults.decision: The narrator prompt was re-emitted as split raw-text files (system/user/schema) so the brain could page through it.
afkDefaults.why: The CLI emits one 220KB single-line JSON file; a line-oriented Read cannot chunk it and the first narrator dispatch failed outright. Content was passed through byte-for-byte by work/daily-2026-08-07/split_prompt.py — nothing was summarised or altered.
